verdict.rationale: sevDesk connects business bank accounts (over 4,000 banks) and lets users map invoices to bank payments, flagging missing receipts. That covers the matching side and part of surfacing unmatched items. Nothing shows a per-account reconciliation against the ledger or duplicate detection. Missing for 10: per-bank-account reconciliation against the ledger, explicit matched/unmatched review views, duplicate transaction detection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: Map invoices directly to your bank payments. See when receipts are missing.
Seamlessly merge your business account and bookkeeping and pay your invoices directly from sevdesk.
